stages.name: focused-v1
stages.command: env CGO_ENABLED=0 GOAMD64=v1 GOMAXPROCS=2 GOFLAGS=-mod=readonly go -C <worktree> test -p 2 ./rodenteval -run '^TestRodentApplyUpdates' -count=1 -v

stages.name: focused-v3
stages.command: env CGO_ENABLED=0 GOAMD64=v3 GOMAXPROCS=2 GOFLAGS=-mod=readonly go -C <worktree> test -p 2 ./rodenteval -run '^TestRodentApplyUpdates' -count=1 -v

stages.name: oracle-v1
stages.command: env CGO_ENABLED=0 GOAMD64=v1 GOMAXPROCS=2 GOFLAGS=-mod=readonly <five pinned Rodent env inputs> go -C <worktree> test -p 2 -tags rodentoracle ./rodenteval -count=1 -v

stages.name: oracle-v3
stages.command: env CGO_ENABLED=0 GOAMD64=v3 GOMAXPROCS=2 GOFLAGS=-mod=readonly <five pinned Rodent env inputs> go -C <worktree> test -p 2 -tags rodentoracle ./rodenteval -count=1 -v

stages.name: engine-rodent-v3
stages.command: env CGO_ENABLED=0 GOAMD64=v3 GOMAXPROCS=2 GOFLAGS=-mod=readonly RODENT_V11_ANAND_MODEL=<pinned> go -C <worktree> test -p 2 -tags rodentoracle ./engine -run Rodent -count=1 -v

stages.name: full-short-v3
stages.command: env CGO_ENABLED=0 GOAMD64=v3 GOMAXPROCS=2 GOFLAGS=-mod=readonly go -C <worktree> test -short -p 2 ./... -count=1

stages.name: full-short-race-v3
stages.command: env GOAMD64=v3 GOMAXPROCS=2 GOFLAGS=-mod=readonly go -C <worktree> test -short -race -p 2 ./... -count=1

held_speed_gate_proposal.mechanism: Reuse the accepted Rodent output-kernel paired driver, six fixed fixtures, exact cold/warm identity snapshots, v3/v3 matched binaries, alternating execution order, and clean CPU-affinity supervision.
held_speed_gate_proposal.direct_check: Add one private test-only benchmark for portable versus selected 2/3/4-row kernels over preloaded captured update rows; require every row class and the aggregate to improve with 0 B/op and 0 allocs/op.
held_speed_gate_proposal.acceptance: Across the same repeated paired blocks, require candidate/base median search time <= 0.97 (at least 3% less time), every fixture median < 1, both execution-order strata < 1, exact callback/PV/score/node/context identity, and identical allocation counts.
held_speed_gate_proposal.failure: Reject on any correctness/identity/dispatch failure, any fixture regression, or a non-repeatable/sub-3% search gain.
